facts.fact: According to Sprout Social's social media benchmarks by industry (a third-party source), average inbound engagements on brand content climbed 20% year over year in 2024.

facts.fact: The page defines Engagement Rate (ER) as (total engagements divided by total followers) multiplied by 100.
The page organizes social media metrics into four funnel stages: awareness, consideration, conversion, and retention.
facts.quote: Four stages that make reporting clearer

facts.quote: an engagement rate above 1% on Instagram can trigger algorithmic amplification

facts.quote: **a 1% uplift in CTR can drive 15% to 30% more leads for e-commerce SMBs**

facts.fact: Citing Power Digital, video CTAs with high view duration can boost conversion rates by 25% (third-party claim).

facts.fact: Click-through rate is calculated as (Clicks / Impressions) x 100.
Conversion rate is calculated as (Conversions / Clicks) x 100.
Adwave recommends one weekly check-in and one monthly review for a small-business social analytics routine.
facts.quote: The simplest working system is one weekly check-in and one monthly review.
